submission.justification: Crystal-K1 gives the best simulated resolution (2.88% FWHM at 5 cm), but its measured intrinsic background is 2.0 counts/kg/day, four times the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day, so it is unsuitable for low-background operation. Crystal-K2 meets the background budget (0.10) but its resolution is about 8.5% FWHM. Crystal-K3 meets the budget (0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day) and gives the best resolution among compliant options: 4.78% FWHM at 5 cm. Thickness scan for K3: 2 cm 5.33%, 3 cm 4.88%, 5 cm 4.78%, 8 cm 5.14%, 10 cm 6.45%, so 5 cm is near the optimum. The 5 cm choice is within the 2-10 cm limit.
